I would strongly recommend Mahoney and Da Silva to anyone looking for a solar and battery installation. Out of the three companies that provided quotes, they were the only one to come and quote in person. This was really important, as our roof is very different to how it appears on Google Map's satellite images! They even managed to work around the complex shade issues provided by trees near our property, and delivered a perfectly optimised system.When the time to install it all came, they were punctual, courteous and worked very efficiently. We had a quite a few spells of bad weather, but they always took the opportunity to finish the job as quickly as possible when the good weather rolled around. They had great communication throughout the whole quote and install; I was never left wondering when they would show up.Since the install, the solar and battery system has been perfect for our needs and hasn't skipped a beat. I think we'll definitely contact them again in the summer when we want to change our gas hot water system over to a heat pump.

This is the third system I've had installed, with both the previous ones being done by large/mid scale installers, and both were trouble free with a satisfactory process and outcome. This time around I decided to try one of the three referred by Solar quotes and I chose this small scale owner-operator expecting a more personalised and still trouble free process and more active customer service. I was keen to support a small developing business.The quote process was straightforward and David was happy to provide a number of versions as we worked through the options to deal with my own and council's requirements (heritage overlay). The installation was also relatively straightforward, after we had one agreed reschedule just before Christmas. It was completed after the holiday period over 2 days. Once completed I was advised about the need to connect the system to the internet on an ongoing basis, which was news to me and had not been raised before. We are low internet users and rely on a 4G Mobile Internet Device which meets all our needs. However the Goodwe inverter would not connect. To cut a long story short various attempts to connect the system using different equipment did not succeed. Over a number of months, including supposedly waiting for Goodwe to supply a new WI-FI Dongle, the customer service deteriorated to the point that David stopped responding to calls and messages. Eventually I resorted to calling Evan and he was appropriately responsive and made significant efforts to connect the system without success. Eventually I was left to contact Goodwe directly, which I did a number of times, with Evan also not returning my call. After a number of calls and following Goodwe's advice eventually the system connected, but it was still not exporting any power (I know the current feed-in tariff is insignificant, but that's not the point). Eventually, just a few weeks ago (in August) I assume Goodwe discovered the export problem related to the post installation paperwork not been completed. Suddenly I received advice from my distributer and retailer advising receipt of relevant paperwork from the installer, and soon enough as if by magic the system was registered and exporting - all the while not a word from the installer. Throughout the post installation process I was made to feel like a difficult hard to satisfy customer, when in fact it seems that the problem all along was incomplete documentation by the installer. And still not a call to explain the issue, it's resolution, let alone any admission of responsibility or expression of regret. On that basis I can't recommend this installer. Next time I will likely stick to an established reputable higher volume provider with an established customer service charter and a issue resolution process that works and is not person dependent.
